name: Commerce: Admin Payment
description: Submodule of Commerce: Admin Checkout. Adds an 'admin manual' payment gateway/type and a checkout pane so administrators can stage manual payments against an order (e.g. record cash, or apply payments as discounts), gated by the 'apply admin payments in checkout' permission. Requires Commerce Multiple Payments.
project_description: Sub-module of Commerce: Admin Checkout. Enables Drupal Commerce administrators to use custom multi-payment payment types on the checkout form. It requires the Commerce Multiple Payments module and lets you define "admin payments" which site administrators can add to an order to reduce the price paid (possibly up to the total of the order) - useful for using payments in a way similar to discounts, e.g. accounting for employee discounts as payments. Adds one checkout pane: Apply Manual Payments.
